paragraph_requires: Diluted net loss per share is the same as basic net loss per common share for all periods presented
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Axogen reports equal basic and diluted net loss per share because potentially dilutive securities would be anti-dilutive. Its EPS note identifies stock options, restricted stock units and performance stock units, and separately lists excluded share equivalents. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the thousands heading. Excluded potential shares are not added to the reported denominator, and basic and diluted denominators should not be added together.

table_requires: Shares used in computing basic and diluted net loss per share
paragraph_requires: Because we have incurred a net loss for all periods presented
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Heron excludes common stock equivalents from loss per share because their effect would be anti-dilutive. The statement presents weighted-average shares in thousands and its inline facts encode scale three; these pages retain the resulting share counts. Per-share figures are exempt from that scale. Basic and diluted measures retain distinct definitions; matching denominators should not be added.

potentially dilutive shares, comprised of unvested RSUs
decisions.reader_note: For 2024–2025, Westwater excludes potentially dilutive shares associated with unvested restricted stock units, stock options and convertible notes because their effect on loss per share would be anti-dilutive. The disclosed potential shares at period end are not weighted-average shares used in EPS. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the statement’s thousands heading. The reported denominators are retained without adding excluded potential shares or adding basic and diluted counts.
